info.title: MMO API
info.description: Production-ready Rust API server with JWT authentication, MongoDB, and Redis

get.description: Get shop statistics for admin dashboard. Requires admin role.

post.description: Set custom commission rate for a specific shop. Admin only.
Start wallet background jobs (escrow auto-release, reconciliation, USDT monitoring, auto-escalate)
Stop wallet background jobs (escrow auto-release, reconciliation, USDT monitoring, auto-escalate)

get.description: Get wallet dashboard statistics for admin monitoring and analytics. Includes total wallets, pending escrows, dispute counts, and more.

post.description: Admin manually debits from a user's wallet. Used for penalties or corrections.
Manually credit funds to a user's wallet (admin operation)

400.description: Bad request - invalid amount or reason

post.description: Create auto deposit request for monitoring specific payment methods. Admin only.
Admin manually credits a user's wallet. Used for processing manual deposit requests with proof.
Payment gateway webhook callback to process deposit status updates. Admin endpoint for security.

400.description: Bad request - invalid signature or payload

get.description: List all deposits across the platform with filtering and pagination

post.description: Background job (cron) to process auto-escalate and auto-resolve disputes. Runs every 30 minutes. Handles: (1) Seller no response within 48h → auto-escalate, (2) Buyer no response within 24h → auto-escalate OR auto-resolve if seller accepted.

403.description: Forbidden - Admin or internal service only

post.description: Admin processes partial refund with buyer/seller percentage split. Commission is deducted from seller's portion (5%). Example: buyer_percent=70 means buyer gets 70%, seller gets 25% (after 5% commission).
Admin extends dispute deadline by 1-7 days. Used when more time is needed for resolution.
Background job (cron) to auto-release escrows after 72 hours. Releases funds to seller when no disputes are created within the dispute period.

post.summary: POST /admin/api/wallet/escrow/{escrow_id}/resolve/refund - Admin resolves dispute with refund
post.description: Admin resolves a dispute by refunding the buyer. Full amount refunded to buyer, escrow released.

post.summary: POST /admin/api/wallet/escrow/{escrow_id}/resolve/release - Admin resolves dispute with release to seller
post.description: Admin resolves a dispute by releasing funds to seller. Commission deducted, net amount to seller.
Freeze wallet to prevent all transactions. Admin only.

get.description: Get admin operation logs for audit trail. Supports filtering by target ID.

post.description: Trigger daily wallet reconciliation to verify balance integrity and detect discrepancies between wallet balances and transaction history.
Unfreeze wallet to allow transactions. Admin only.
Approve withdrawal request and mark it for processing. Admin only.
Mark withdrawal as completed after bank transfer is done. Admin only.
Reject withdrawal request and refund amount to vendor's wallet. Admin only.

get.description: Validate withdrawal request before approval. Checks balance, limits, and bank info.

post.description: Create a new shop for the authenticated vendor. Auto-approves and generates Telegram verification code.

400.description: Bad request - validation failed or shop already exists

get.description: Get vendor's shop dashboard with completion status and statistics.

put.description: Update shop policies (warranty, refund, support hours). Required for shop completion.
Update shop basic information (name, description, logo, banner).

get.description: Get Telegram verification status and instructions for the vendor's shop.
Get wallet balance for the authenticated user. Returns available balance and pending balance (for vendors).

post.summary: POST /api/wallet/deposit/initiate - Initiate deposit via payment gateway
post.description: Initiate a new deposit request through payment gateway (bank transfer, Momo, USDT, etc.)

400.description: Bad request - invalid amount or payment method

get.description: Check the status of a specific deposit transaction
Get the current user's deposit history with pagination

get.summary: GET /api/wallet/disputes - List disputes for current user
get.description: List all disputes for the current user (as buyer or seller). Supports pagination and filtering.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (PENDING, SELLER_RESPONDED, BUYER_RESPONDED, ESCALATED, RESOLVED, REFUNDED, PARTIAL_REFUND, REJECTED, CLOSED, EXTENDED)

get.description: Get detailed dispute information by ID. Both buyer and seller can view their disputes.

post.description: Buyer responds to seller's action. Options: ACCEPT_OFFER (accept seller's partial/full refund offer) or ESCALATE (escalate to admin). Buyer must respond within 24 hours of seller response. Max 3 exchange rounds.

400.description: Bad request - invalid decision or escalation message

post.description: Seller responds to buyer dispute with one of 4 actions: ACCEPT (full refund), PARTIAL_ACCEPT (offer partial refund), REJECT (dispute), REPLACEMENT (offer new items). Seller must respond within 48 hours.

400.description: Bad request - invalid action, amount, or images

post.description: Buyer creates a dispute for an escrow hold. Must be done within 72 hours of purchase.

400.description: Bad request - invalid evidence images or escrow status

post.description: Buyer confirms satisfaction and releases escrow funds to seller early (before 72h auto-release).
Create a purchase order and hold funds in escrow. Buyer only.

get.description: Get transaction history for the authenticated user's wallet. Supports pagination and filtering.

post.description: Create a withdrawal request to transfer funds from wallet to bank account. Vendor only.

400.description: Bad request - insufficient balance or invalid amount

amount.description: Amount to freeze (or None for full freeze)
